[PREFERENCE] User is looking for new recipes using boneless chicken breast.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Boneless chicken breast is an excellent protein choice.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested recipes include:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 1. Grilled Chicken Fajitas: Marinate chicken breast in lime juice, olive oil, garlic, and spices, grill with bell peppers and onions, serve with whole wheat tortillas, sautéed veggies, and brown rice or quinoa.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 2. Chicken and Avocado Salad: Grill or bake chicken breast, chop and mix with diced avocado, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, and feta cheese, top with homemade vinaigrette.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 3. Lemon Rosemary Chicken: Zest a lemon, mix with olive oil, minced garlic, and chopped rosemary, brush on chicken breast, bake, serve with roasted vegetables and quinoa or brown rice.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 4. Chicken and Veggie Stir-Fry: Sauté diced chicken breast with vegetables in olive oil and soy sauce, serve over brown rice or cauliflower rice.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 5. Chicken Tacos: Shred or chop cooked chicken breast, season with taco seasoning, serve in tacos with toppings like salsa, avocado, sour cream, and shredded lettuce.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 6. Chicken and Mushroom Creamy Pasta: Sauté sliced mushrooms and onions, add cooked chicken breast and low-fat cream, serve over whole wheat pasta and steamed vegetables.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 7. Chicken and Spinach Stuffed Bell Peppers: Fill bell peppers with cooked chicken breast, spinach, feta cheese, and brown rice, bake until tender.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 8. Chicken Caesar Wrap: Grill or bake chicken breast, wrap in whole wheat tortilla with romaine lettuce, cherry tomatoes, and homemade Caesar dressing.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 9. Chicken and Quinoa Bowl: Roast chicken breast with spices, serve over quinoa with roasted vegetables and tzatziki sauce.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 10. Chicken and Veggie Kabobs: Skewer chicken breast, cherry tomatoes, mushrooms, and bell peppers, grill or bake, serve with quinoa or brown rice and a side salad.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] These recipes are easy to make and can be customized to fit dietary preferences.
